"import cadquery as cq

# Establish the YZ plane: local (u, v) -> global (0, u, v)
P = cq.Plane.named("YZ")

# Define consecutive local endpoints of the open orthogonal chain
local_points = [
    (-13, -19),  # start of chain
    (-32, -19),  # end of line 1 / start of line 2
    (-32, -37),  # end of line 2 / start of line 3
    (-43, -37),  # end of line 3 / start of line 4
    (-43, -49),  # end of chain
]

# Convert local coordinates to world coordinates on the YZ plane
world_points = [P.toWorldCoords((u, v)) for (u, v) in local_points]

# Create exactly 4 line edges between consecutive world points
edges = [
    cq.Edge.makeLine(world_points[i], world_points[i + 1])
    for i in range(len(world_points) - 1)
]

# Verify we have exactly 4 curve entities
assert len(edges) == 4, f"Expected 4 edges, got {len(edges)}"

# Export the open chain as a compound of edges to sketch.step
cq.exporters.export(cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges), "sketch.step")"
